title: Sort files into folders and index them
prompt: Tidy inbox/: move images (.jpg, .png) into images/, documents (.pdf, .docx, .txt) into documents/, and anything else into other/ (all three at the workspace root). Then write index.md with one line per moved file, `- <new path>`, sorted alphabetically. inbox/ should be empty afterwards.

checks.equals:
- documents/cv.docx
- documents/invoice 2026-10.pdf
- documents/notes.txt
- images/Logo.PNG
- images/beach.jpg
- other/archive.tar.gz
- other/song.mp3

notes: Extensions are matched case-insensitively (Logo.PNG is an image). index.md is sorted by plain code-point order, so uppercase sorts first.
